'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornado outbreak of December 13–14, 2022]]
**An ongoing [[tornado outbreak]] across the [[United States]] kills three people, injures dozens of others, and leaves hundreds of people homeless. [https://weather.com/storms/tornado/news/2022-12-13-severe-weather-forecast-thunderstorms-south-tornadoes-wind-damage (The Weather Channel)]

**[[Kosovo]] formally signs a request to become a member of the [[European Union]]. [[Serbia]] condemns the request and says that it will ask the five members of the bloc which [[International recognition of Kosovo|do not recognize Kosovo]] to reject the request. '''Sports'''
*[[2022 FIFA World Cup]]
**The defending champions [[France national football team|France]] [[2022 FIFA World Cup knockout stage#France vs Morocco|defeats]] [[Morocco national football team|Morocco]] 2–0, advancing to their second consecutive [[2022 FIFA World Cup final|World Cup final]], which will be against [[Argentina national football team|Argentina]]. France is the first team since [[Brazil national football team|Brazil]] in [[2002 FIFA World Cup final|2002]] to advance to consecutive World Cup finals, and will aim to become the first team since Brazil in [[1962 FIFA World Cup final|1962]] to win consecutive World Cup finals.  [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/12/14/football/france-morocco-semifinal-2022-world-cup-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
